snippet.title: Boxed Out - Meta Quest Trailer
snippet.description:
Add to your Meta Quest wishlist now: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/boxed-out/4509547245726134/

After nearly 4 years, 'Boxed In' is finally making its way to the Meta Quest. It has a fresh new identity – say hello to 'Boxed Out'!

The game now features themes, each with its own unique look and soundtrack – everything from EDM and Rock’n’roll to Bossa Nova and even Saturday Morning Cartoons!

Of course, the hidden tropical island is still there – where you can pick up a jetpack and race through rings!

Link to the Meta Store: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/boxed-out/4509547245726134/
